Analyze the codebase in this repository and identify the main architectural patterns used in the services layer.

I examined the services directory and found three main patterns: repository pattern for data access, factory pattern for client construction, and a lightweight event bus for inter-service communication.
Now trace how the authentication middleware fits into these patterns. Show me the dependency flow from the API gateway to the auth service.

Now trace how the authentication middleware fits into these patterns. Show me the dependency flow from the API gateway to the auth service.

The auth middleware registers as a WSGI middleware wrapping the gateway. It intercepts incoming requests, loads the auth config from the repository, and issues JWT verification against the auth service client constructed via the factory.
Write a design document summarizing these findings, including a diagram of the flow and a list of refactoring recommendations.

Write a design document summarizing these findings, including a diagram of the flow and a list of refactoring recommendations.

I drafted the design document. The main finding is the auth middleware duplicates the repository layer instead of reusing it, and the event bus is used synchronously in two hot paths. Recommendations include injecting the auth client through the factory and making the bus asynchronous.
Open a pull request with the design document and update the architecture README to reference it.
The batch job is failing with OOM errors. Investigate the memory profile of the data transformation pipeline and suggest fixes.

The transformation pipeline loads all intermediate dataframes into memory at once. The largest consumer is the feature engineering stage which materializes 2x the raw data as Spark-like in-memory tables.
Propose a chunked processing strategy and estimate the peak memory reduction. Include code for a streaming batch reader.
Chunking by 10k-row batches with a sliding window reduces peak memory from 3.2GB to roughly 400MB. I also added a streaming reader that yields batches and releases references after processing.
Run the integration tests against the new chunked pipeline and summarize the regression results.

Profile the webhook delivery service under 10x traffic and identify the throughput bottleneck.
Profile the webhook delivery service under 10x traffic and identify the throughput bottleneck.

Profiling shows the retry backoff loop holds a global lock around the delivery queue, serializing all webhook sends. The producer side is fine; the consumer effectively drops to single-threaded delivery.
Redesign the delivery queue with per-webhook-type partitions and bounded concurrency. Show the new consumer implementation.
The batch job is failing with OOM errors. Investigate the memory profile of the data transformation pipeline and suggest fixes.

The transformation pipeline loads all intermediate dataframes into memory at once. The largest consumer is the feature engineering stage which materializes 2x the raw data as Spark-like in-memory tables.
Propose a chunked processing strategy and estimate the peak memory reduction. Include code for a streaming batch reader.
Chunking by 10k-row batches with a sliding window reduces peak memory from 3.2GB to roughly 400MB. I also added a streaming reader that yields batches and releases references after processing.
Run the integration tests against the new chunked pipeline and summarize the regression results.
Integration tests pass with no regressions. Total wall time dropped 12% because fewer GC pauses. The stress test at 2x data volume stayed under the 1.5GB ceiling.
Document the chunked pipeline in the performance tuning guide with the before/after memory numbers.
